analyst.summary: TSF Investments (formerly Sundaram Finance Holdings) is an investment holding company for twelve Sundaram/TVS-group businesses whose reported revenue jumped over 500% this year — but this is a subsidiary/portfolio consolidation event, not organic growth, and profitability (ROE 8%, ROCE 3%) has not improved proportionately. The underlying business is best understood as a holding vehicle whose value tracks its investee stakes' earnings and dividends, growing at a much more modest pace than the headline revenue figure suggests. We rate it a Hold, flagged for the committee's attention on the growth-scoring methodology point.
